name: OBS Studio
summary: Record screens and compose live streams.
description: OBS Studio combines video and audio sources into scenes for recording or streaming. Hardware encoding and capture support depend on the machine and selected release.

license.notes: Upstream license indicator only; redistribution, dependency notices and any model/asset licenses await legal review.

requirements.platform: Upstream targets Windows; the exact Windows version, architecture and compatibility matrix have not been selected or tested.
requirements.hardware: Encoding demands vary with resolution, frame rate, sources and CPU/GPU. Recording files can consume substantial disk space.
requirements.disk: Unknown for a RepoReady distribution. Measure installer, installed files, working data and optional downloads before approval.
requirements.modelDownloads: Core workflow has no required model identified in this research; optional AI features or plugins require separate review.
requirements.network: Local recording and external streaming have different network requirements.
requirements.privacy: Captures can include sensitive windows, microphones and cameras. Streaming sends selected content to the configured service.
requirements.apiCharges: Core recording does not require a paid API; streaming platforms and optional plugins may charge.
